news.title: Anthropic's Claude Code Artifacts update brings live, shared dashboards and interactive workspaces to enterprises
news.summary_raw: Anthropic announced a potentially game-changing new feature for users of Claude Code on the Claude Team and Enterprise subscription plans: Artifacts. This update turns a Claude Code session's work into a live, interactive, and shareable, custom HTML webpage, allowing a Claude Code user to plug in live code, multiple data sources, and have it surface on an interactive URL that they can send to other teammates — be it a dashboard, an app design, or some other product meant for internal usage.
news.summary: Anthropic has released an update to its Claude Code feature, introducing live, shared dashboards and interactive workspaces via Artifacts. This allows Claude Code users to create and share custom HTML webpages with live code and real-time data.
news.enterprise_use: Check your Claude Code settings this week; inaction means missing out on the ability to create and share interactive, real-time dashboards with your team. This impacts your ability to collaborate effectively and utilize Claude Code to its full potential, particularly for projects and workflows requiring simultaneous collaboration.

news.title: Ire identifies another LOTUSLITE specimen
news.summary_raw:
Project Ire examined a timely malware sample and determined its intent through reverse engineering—identifying LOTUSLITE characteristics even as most major EDR tools did not detect it.
The post Ire identifies another LOTUSLITE specimen appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research's Project Ire identified another LOTUSLITE malware specimen through reverse engineering, which most major EDR tools failed to detect. This highlights a gap in cybersecurity detection.
news.enterprise_use: Check your CrowdStrike or other EDR tool's settings to ensure it can detect LOTUSLITE malware, ensuring you're not missing critical threats. Failing to do so means relying on outdated signatures or manual review for this specific threat. CrowdStrike is most affected here, with other EDR tools potentially lagging behind.

news.title: MosaicLeaks: Can your research agent keep a secret?
